audit.whatIsWrong: Akshan's camouflage is attributed to his passive in four separate places (spikes[2], whys[4], wants.foe[2], and the mid/late prose). Dirty Fighting (P) grants bonus damage on every third hit, a shield, and an extra reduced-damage attack — no stealth. The camouflage belongs to Going Rogue (W). Separately, wants.foe[1] credits the shield to Avengerang; Avengerang has no shield, the shield is Dirty Fighting's.
audit.why: Both are attribution errors against Riot's own ability text in the kit file. A player told to track 'his passive' for camouflage will never learn that Going Rogue is a castable he can be punished for having on cooldown (18s at rank 1, dropping to 2s at rank 5).
audit.corrected: All camouflage references now name Going Rogue (W); the shield is attributed to Dirty Fighting (P) only.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer describes Heroic Swing as a 'camera swing escape' — not a mechanic — and nowhere states its two real constraints: it requires terrain to anchor to, and he is knocked off the swing when he collides with a champion.
audit.why: Riot's E text states both. They are the two things that let you deny his only skirmish tool: fight away from side walls, and body-block the arc.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, the Key Ability Interactions entry, and dosFull[0], with E's 18s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase reason is generic Jayce boilerplate ('Form-swapping IS the ult') and says nothing about why the lane actually tilts at 6.
audit.why: The content layer correctly identifies 6 as Akshan's window because of Comeuppance plus camouflage roams against a Jayce whose R grants no new burst. The full layer left that out.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around Comeuppance and Going Rogue roams.

audit.why: The content spikes correctly place Jayce's window at levels 1-2 before Heroic Swing is levelled, Akshan's at 3 and 6, and Jayce's recovery at two items against a lethality frame. No correction needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere; the packet's suspectNames entry for 'His Comeuppance' is a false positive (Comeuppance is the correct name).
audit.why: Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and Avengerang 9/8/7/6/5s are the two timers that decide when a step-up is safe. Avengerang also damages on the return leg, which the page never mentions.
audit.corrected: Both added to breakdown.cooldowns with the return-leg detail.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] ('Swap to hammer when he closes') and dontsFull[1] ('Burn both forms together') carry descriptions copied from unrelated template lines.
audit.why: Mismatched title/description pairs give no usable instruction.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their titles with real mechanics.

edits.before: Comeuppance plus his passive camouflage make him a roam threat, and your R is just a stance-swap (no level-6 burst), so the map pressure tilts to him.
edits.after: Comeuppance plus Going Rogue (W) camouflage make him a roam threat, and your R is just a stance-swap (no level-6 burst), so map pressure tilts to him.

edits.before: His Comeuppance ult and passive camouflage make him a roam threat while your R is just a stance-swap with no level-6 burst — the window is his.
edits.after: His Comeuppance ult and Going Rogue (W) camouflage make him a roam threat while your R is just a stance-swap with no new burst — the window is his.

edits.before: Proc his Dirty Fighting passive shield in trades and use Avengerang's shield to absorb your cannon chip
edits.after: Proc Dirty Fighting (P) every third hit — that is where his shield comes from, and it eats your cannon chip

edits.before: Use passive camouflage + roam timers around 6 to flank picks and snowball off his revive marks elsewhere
edits.after: Use Going Rogue (W) camouflage and roam timers at 6 to flank picks and snowball off his revive marks

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing (E), 18s at rank 1: it needs terrain to grapple, and colliding with a champion knocks him off it — stand in the arc. - Avengerang (Q), 9s at rank 1: the boomerang hits twice, so sidestep the return leg too.

edits.before: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Gate-Q poke + hammer knock.
edits.after: Heroic Swing (E) needs a wall to anchor and drops him on champion collision — body-block the arc, then gate-Q the landing.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: No wall in range means no swing — fight him in the open lane, away from side terrain.

edits.before: Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Thundering Blow knocks him out of the swing and off his dive angle.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Dirty Fighting (P) shields every third hit — burst him, do not chip.

edits.before: Form-swapping IS the ult — six abilities against his four. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Comeuppance and Going Rogue camouflage turn him into a roamer; your R is only a stance swap. Ward his flanks, do not over-shove.

notes: The full layer's report[5].t contained the phrase 'camera swing escape', which is not a mechanic — I read it as a corrupted paraphrase and replaced it with the two verified constraints from Riot's E text. Note that the content-layer 'win' array and the packet levelChart disagree for this matchup (content gives Jayce levels 2-3 and both item stages; the packet gives Akshan levels 3 through first item). I did not change any phase sides — the enum values are too short to survive the applier's +/-10% length band — so the disagreement stands and needs a mirror-fix pass.
